Alwida Ya husain Ai husain Alwida
Alwida Ya husain Ai husain Alwida

1
Roke boli bahan ai husain alwida
Shaam o kufa ki raaho se lejaenge
Ye laeen har qadam par sitam dhaenge
Bandh rahi hai rasan

2
Jiska har phul hai yaadgar e iram
Aah karbobala me badaste sitam
Lutgaya woh chaman

3
Yaad aata rahega tera waqeya
Tujhko rota rahega zamana sada
Aie gharibul watan

4
Aaj tabut e sarwar se lipte raho
Aaj rote raho aur kehte raho
Haye shaahe zaman

5
Shaih ki ruksat hai viraan hai sara ghar
Kyu na hum bhi kahei peetkar apna sar
Ai shahe zulmenan

6
Matami farsh ab ghar se uthne lage
Taziye khane viraan hone lage
Aie shahe bekafan

7
Saal bhar apni aankhei bhigoenge hum
Dekhkar behte pani ko roenge hum
Haaye tashnadahan

8
Aie "Faseel" aarahi hai yeh kiski sada
Aie mere laal uthta hai farshe azaa
Haaye zakhmi badan

p=Path('src/data/lyrics/alwida-ya-husain-ae-husain-alwida.md')
_, meta, body=p.read_text().split('---\\n',2)
roman=meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1]
groups=lambda s: [b.splitlines() for b in s.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
r,b=groups(roman),groups(body)
assert [len(x) for x in r]==[len(x) for x in b]==[2,5,4,4,4,4,4,4,4]
assert [x[0] for x in b[1:]]==list('۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸')
assert all(not line or line.startswith('  ') for line in roman.splitlines())
assert 'noUrdu' not in meta and '\\u200c' not in body
print('27 paired verses across the opening and eight stanzas')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 27 verses in Urdu script, preserving the two-line opening and eight stanzas. Kept the Roman wording in `romanLyrics` with capitalization normalized and verified that the verse counts match in every block. Set the direction to RTL, added the Roman alternate title, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read the ambiguous Roman forms `Shaih`, `zulmenan`, and `Faseel` as شاہ, ذوالمنن, and فصیل.
